title: Enhancement: [Nexthop] Fix CPU temp and add more temp sensors
author: louis-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the enhancement

1. To add more temperature sensors, so fans can react to the change of temperature of the unit better.
2. Bug: CPU_TEMP in NH-4010 and NH-4020 accidentally used sysfs access type ([here](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/ec2c6d843271688868e537c37f1bf83687821cf2/device/nexthop/x86_64-nexthop_4010-r0/pddf/pddf-device.json.j2#L489-L497)) which is not implemented in upstream.
3. Bug: critical high threshold and critical low threshold of current sensor and voltage sensor aren't reported

### Current Behavior

For bug no.2, thermalctld crashed out and fans were set to 100%:
```
ERR pmon#nh_thermal[48]: ThermalControlAlgorithmAction: Traceback:#012Traceback (most recent call last):#012  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/sonic_platform/thermal_actions.py", line 175, in execute#012    self._execute_raise_on_error(thermal_info_dict)#012  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/sonic_platform/thermal_actions.py", line 207, in _execute_raise_on_error#012    pid_output, max_error_thermal = self._compute_domain_pid_output(domain, domain_thermal_list)#012                                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^#012  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/sonic_platform/thermal_actions.py", line 324, in _compute_domain_pid_output#012    raise ValueError(f"No valid thermal found for domain '{domain}'")#012ValueError: No valid thermal found for domain 'main'
ERR pmon#nh_thermal[48]: ThermalControlAlgorithmAction: Setting fan speed to 100.0% (max)
ERR pmon#thermalctld[48]: Caught exception while running thermal policy - ValueError("No valid thermal found for domain 'main'")
```

CPU temp is not available:
```
$ show plat temp | egrep "Timestamp|----|CPU"
                Sensor    Temperature    High TH    Low TH    Crit High TH    Crit Low TH    Warning          Timestamp
----------------------  -------------  ---------  --------  --------------  -------------  ---------  -----------------
                   CPU            N/A        N/A       N/A             N/A            N/A      False  20251002 00:03:38
```

For bug no.3, `show plat current` and `show plat voltage` are missing "Crit {High|Low} TH" of many sensors:
```
$ show plat voltage
      Sensor     Voltage    High TH    Low TH    Crit High TH    Crit Low TH    Warning          Timestamp
------------  ----------  ---------  --------  --------------  -------------  ---------  -----------------
 POS0V9_EAST    899.0 mV       1080       720               0              0      False  20251001 23:50:38

POS0V78_ASIC    770.0 mV       1500       500            1799            200      False  20251001 23:50:38
  POS0V78_S0    781.0 mV        858       701               0              0      False  20251001 23:50:38
      POS1V0    998.0 mV       1049       899               0              0      False  20251001 23:50:38

   POS1V2_A7   1199.0 mV       1260      1080               0              0      False  20251001 23:50:38

      POS3V3   3295.0 mV       3464      2970               0              0      False  20251001 23:50:38

   POS3V3_S0   3333.0 mV       3464      2970               0              0      False  20251001 23:50:38

     POS12V0  12205.0 mV      13199     10800               0              0      False  20251001 23:50:38
```

### Proposed Behavior

1. Add more DCDC temp sensors
2. Fix bug by using the `sysfs_base_path` approach which is available upstream [here](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/ec2c6d843271688868e537c37f1bf83687821cf2/platform/pddf/platform-api-pddf-base/sonic_platform_pddf_base/pddfapi.py#L392-L394).
3. Fix bug by updating `drv_attr_name` of the sensor's attribute in `pddf-device.json` to get the correct one in sysfs

#### Why I did it

Fixes #24182

1. To add 5 DCDC temp sensor, so that `nh_thermal.py` can react to the change in temperature better (e.g. adjusting fans' speed)
2. Fix CPU temp sensor. Right now, `pddfapi.py` doesn't know where in sysfs to get the temp value from CPU temp sensor, so thermalctld crash out:
```
ERR pmon#nh_thermal[48]: ThermalControlAlgorithmAction: Traceback:#012Traceback (most recent call last):#012  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/sonic_platform/thermal_actions.py", line 175, in execute#012    self._execute_raise_on_error(thermal_info_dict)#012  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/sonic_platform/thermal_actions.py", line 207, in _execute_raise_on_error#012    pid_output, max_error_thermal = self._compute_domain_pid_output(domain, domain_thermal_list)#012                                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^#012  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/sonic_platform/thermal_actions.py", line 324, in _compute_domain_pid_output#012    raise ValueError(f"No valid thermal found for domain '{domain}'")#012ValueError: No valid thermal found for domain 'main'
ERR pmon#nh_thermal[48]: ThermalControlAlgorithmAction: Setting fan speed to 100.0% (max)
ERR pmon#thermalctld[48]: Caught exception while running thermal policy - ValueError("No valid thermal found for domain 'main'")

$ show plat temp | egrep "Timestamp|----|CPU"
                Sensor    Temperature    High TH    Low TH    Crit High TH    Crit Low TH    Warning          Timestamp
----------------------  -------------  ---------  --------  --------------  -------------  ---------  -----------------
                   CPU            N/A        N/A       N/A             N/A            N/A      False  20251002 00:03:38
```
3. Fix `drv_attr_name` of voltage's and current's critical low threshold and critical high threshold to use the correct hwmon attribute. Currently, "Crit High TH" and "Crit Low TH" are not reported properly:
```
$ show plat voltage
      Sensor     Voltage    High TH    Low TH    Crit High TH    Crit Low TH    Warning          Timestamp
------------  ----------  ---------  --------  --------------  -------------  ---------  -----------------

 POS0V9_WEST    899.0 mV       1080       720               0              0      False  20251001 23:50:38
POS0V75_EAST    749.0 mV        900       600               0              0      False  20251001 23:50:38
  POS0V75_S0    747.0 mV        825       674               0              0      False  20251001 23:50:38
  POS0V75_S5    748.0 mV        825       674               0              0      False  20251001 23:50:38
POS0V75_WEST    749.0 mV        900       600               0              0      False  20251001 23:50:38
...
```
4. We changed the product name / model name to `NH-4010-F` and `NH-4020-F` recently.

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

1. Just add more DCDC temp sensors in `pddf-device.json.j2` and update the list of thermals in `platform.json`.
2. Update HWMON0 / CPU_TEMP to use `sysfs_base_path` approach [here](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/ec2c6d843271688868e537c37f1bf83687821cf2/platform/pddf/platform-api-pddf-base/sonic_platform_pddf_base/pddfapi.py#L392-L394) which is available upstream. Since the number of hwmon may change, we rely on `readlink -f /sys/devices/pci0000:00/0000:00:18.3/hwmon/hwmon*` to get the real path.
3. Update `drv_attr_name` of voltage's and current's critical low threshold and critical high threshold.
4. Update chassis's name to have `-F` suffix to match the current product name.

If PR needs to be backported, then the PR must be tested against the base branch and the earliest backport release branch and provide tested image version on these two branches.
